expected_result: Work Orders NOT in nav. Sales Rep has Work Orders = Off.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Sales Representative role has the Work Orders module Off. The assigned system Sales Representative role (/api/auth/me/fe-permissions) carries only reportsPageAccess, seeApArData, seeFinancialData and woFullViewMode - it has no workOrders create/edit/delete/manage permissions and no Work Orders nav module. So the Work Orders item must not appear in the navigation for this role.
expected_plain: When logged in as a Sales Rep, the Work Orders menu item should not appear anywhere in the top/side navigation, and trying to open the Work Orders area directly should not land on a Work Orders screen.
actual_result_plain: Logged in as Tech assigned the Sales Representative system role. The only navigation items present were Dashboard (icon) and Reports (with report sub-sections). There was NO Work Orders item in the nav. Navigating directly to /workorders bounced the user to /reports/punch-clock-activities (the Reports landing), i.e. the Work Orders module UI is not reachable.
notes: Nav-level expectation met: no Work Orders module link, and /workorders redirects to Reports. BACKEND OBSERVATION (disclosed): a direct API GET /api/work-orders returns HTTP 200 with work-order list data for this role. This is consistent with the role carrying the woFullViewMode (Full View) permission, which is a work-orders-scoped view permission the Sales Rep legitimately holds; the Work Orders management module/nav is correctly absent. Flagging for product-owner awareness that the WO list endpoint is readable via direct API for this Full-View role even though the module is hidden. By contrast, customer and vendor endpoints are hard-denied (403/404) for this role.

expected_result: Accessible. Sales Rep has Reports ON and See Financial Data ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Sales Representative role has Reports page access ON (reportsPageAccess) and See Financial Data ON (seeFinancialData cross-toggle true). So the Reports area must open and financial figures (dollar amounts) must be visible.
expected_plain: A Sales Rep should be able to open the Reports area and see reports including financial dollar figures.
actual_result_plain: Logged in as Tech-as-Sales-Representative. The Reports area was the default landing (home redirected to /reports/punch-clock-activities). Navigating to /reports opened the Reports module with a full left-hand report catalog: LABOR (Timesheet Activities), PERFORMANCE (Sales, Technician Efficiency, Advisor Analysis, Shop Efficiency), FINANCE (Sales Tax Collected), ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and ACCOUNTS PAYABLE report groups, plus IBS Batches, QB Unexported, Notes and Reminders. Opening A/R Aging Summary rendered real financial data with dollar amounts and a grand total of $271,834.78, confirming See Financial Data is ON.
notes: Reports access confirmed via UI (module opens, report catalog and data render). fe-permissions for the assigned role include reportsPageAccess and cross_toggle seeFinancialData=true. Financial dollar figures visible in A/R Aging Summary (see sr-59.png).

expected_result: Accessible. Sales Rep has Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Sales Representative role has See AP/AR data ON (seeApArData permission and cross_toggle seeApArData=true), so the Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable reports must be accessible with data.
expected_plain: A Sales Rep should be able to open the A/R and A/P reports and see the aging data.
actual_result_plain: Logged in as Tech-as-Sales-Representative. The Reports left nav showed an ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE group (A/R Aging Summary, A/R Aging Detail, A/R Aging Collection) and an ACCOUNTS PAYABLE group (A/P Aging Summary, A/P Aging Detail, A/P Unpaid Invoices). Opening A/R Aging Summary (/reports/ar-aging-summary) loaded the report in full - a customer-by-customer aging table with Current / 1-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 91-and-over buckets and totals (grand total $271,834.78). The route did not redirect or show access-denied, confirming AP/AR access.
notes: AP/AR access confirmed via UI (A/R Aging Summary renders real data). fe-permissions include seeApArData; cross_toggle seeApArData=true. Both A/R and A/P report groups present in the Reports nav.
